tldr: RestGPT is an LLM-based framework that connects large language models with real-world RESTful APIs using a coarse-to-fine online planning mechanism, enabling complex task decomposition and API selection.
contributions: First work to connect LLMs with RESTful APIs, compatible with existing real-world applications and providing extensibility
Proposed RestGPT, a coarse-to-fine online planning framework addressing API understanding, planning, and response parsing challenges
Built RestBench, a human-annotated benchmark with two practical scenarios (TMDB movie database and Spotify music player)
Demonstrated superior performance over baselines with 75% success rate on TMDB and over 70% on Spotify
methods: RestGPT comprises three modules: a Planner that generates natural language sub-tasks iteratively, an API Selector that maps sub-tasks to API calling plans by reading endpoint descriptions from OpenAPI Specifications, and an Executor containing a Caller and a Parser. The Caller generates API parameters using filtered API documents and produces a response description for the Parser. The Parser leverages LLM coding capability to generate Python code from OAS response schemas for information extraction. The system operates in an iterative plan-and-execute loop with 'continue' and 'end' signals for flexible online planning.
results: RestGPT achieved 75% success rate on TMDB and over 70% on Spotify, outperforming baselines: Offline (29%), DEPS (38%), ReAct (44%), and Reflexion (52%) on TMDB. It had minimal solution length compared to baselines. With text-davinci-003 as the base LLM, performance was best; ChatGPT performed slightly worse; Llama2-13B could not comprehend prompts; Vicuna-13B completed only simple instructions. Correct path rate was slightly higher than success rate across most cases.
limitations: Majority of errors occur during the planning stage—planner loses track after multiple rounds leading to early exit, and API selector hallucinates in-path parameters or selects incorrect APIs. Performance decreases as instruction complexity increases (gold path length grows). Llama2-13B could not generate valid plans at all. ChatGPT tends to be too verbose and continues planning after completion.
